alkylation_reagent.evidence: The pellet was solubilized and digested with the iST kit (PreOmics GmbH, Martinsried, Germany), reduced, and alkylated by addition of sodium deoxycholate (SDC) buffer containing tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP) and 2-chloroacetamide, heated to 95°C for 10 min.
